nodes.title: EDIT ANIMATION STYLE + THREE SHOTS
widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Expressive hand-drawn 2D animation with confident ink outlines, textured gouache backgrounds and two-tone cel shadows in teal, ochre and cream. Strong anticipation poses, elastic squash-and-stretch landings, drawn motion smears and lively follow-through. An asymmetrically striped wooden top dances across a painted maple stage. Maintain the drawn medium through every cut. The top spins fast with a clearly visible teal spiral stripe, hops and lands on a curved wooden ramp; the camera tracks its travel. [Shot 2] At 00:02.020, the camera cuts to a low angle as the spinning top rolls around the ramp, wooden tiles springing upward sequentially behind it. [Shot 3] At 00:04.020, the camera cuts to a high three-quarter view as the top leaps off the ramp and lands spinning at its opening position, the tiles settling in a travelling wave. Maintain consistent subject identity, material and lighting across all three shots.
